page.notes: No marginal notes on this page. The sliver of the neighbouring page at the right edge was left out. The mark after "sententia;" (a star-like sign) is unclear and may be a printing mark; it was not transcribed. The running head word "Iana" may be printed "Jana"; marked [?]. Italic runs follow the scan; the sentence "Sic ille. At haec..." onwards is roman. The catchword "ruptibilis" stands at the right below the last line and is the word completing "cor-".
